summary: Implemented terminal window title support in the Rich repo (not committed, nothing run). Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and allows (ControlType, str) control codes; rich/control.py adds an OSC 0 format entry (ESC ]0;title BEL), Control.title(title) which strips C0 control characters and DEL from the title, and a helper _strip_title_controls; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, which writes the control only when is_terminal and not legacy_windows; tests/test_control.py adds test_control_title and test_control_title_strips_control_characters; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added entry. Tests were not run, so they are unverified. Sanitizing control characters from titles is my own choice and changes output for titles containing control characters.
